# Nanjing Progene Bio — llms.txt

> Nanjing Progene Biotechnology Co., Ltd (南京普诺基生物科技有限公司) — IVD rapid test & POCT OEM/ODM manufacturer.
> 600+ SKUs across 12 series. Colloidal-gold lateral flow + fluorescence immunoassay. GMP facility, Nanjing, China.

## Company
- [About](https://nanjingprogene.com/about/): company profile, certifications, OEM/ODM.
- [Manufacturing](https://nanjingprogene.com/manufacturing/): vertical integration, QC, OEM/ODM capabilities.
- [Certifications](https://nanjingprogene.com/evidence/certifications/): CE (IVDR), ISO 13485, FDA 510(k) partial, FSC.
- [Contact](https://nanjingprogene.com/contact/)
- [RFQ](https://nanjingprogene.com/rfq/): request quote, sample, datasheet, OEM/ODM.

## Product series
- [Drug of Abuse (DOA)](https://nanjingprogene.com/products/): 416 SKUs — THC, COC, AMP, MET, MOP/OPI, BZO, Fentanyl, multi-panel cups.
- [Infectious Disease](https://nanjingprogene.com/products/): 99 SKUs — dengue, malaria, HIV, HBsAg, HCV, H. pylori, syphilis, respiratory.
- [Cardiac & Tumor Markers](https://nanjingprogene.com/products/): troponin, CK-MB, D-dimer, CRP, PCT, PSA, AFP.
- [Women's Health](https://nanjingprogene.com/products/): hCG, LH, FSH, fFN, iGFBP-1.
